one_line: Authenticated user asks to change the email address on file, no tool supports it.
User asks to merge a second duplicate account's order history into their current account.
User disputes sales tax charged on a delivered order and wants it recalculated/refunded.
User reports delivery driver damaged their mailbox, wants complaint filed and compensation.
User wants a formal business invoice plus the company's W9 tax form for accounting.
User requests full account deletion and erasure of all personal data.
User asks to combine two pending orders into a single shipment to save shipping fees.
User wants a forgotten promo code retroactively applied to an already-placed pending order.
User asks agent to reset their website account login password.
User wants to be unsubscribed from marketing emails and promotional robocalls.
User explicitly refuses further chat help and demands a human agent after unresolved exchange.
User wants a price match against a competitor's cheaper listing, refunded as a difference.
User wants a delivered item donated to charity instead of returned, plus a tax receipt.
User reports a phishing email impersonating the company and asks for investigation.
User asks to add a phone number to their account for SMS shipment notifications.
User reports a suspicious account login and asks the agent to lock down their account.
User wants gift wrapping and a gift note added retroactively to a pending order.
User asks how to set up a wholesale business account with negotiated bulk pricing.
